jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides companies of all sizes with an infrastructure platform in the cloud and we are growing our Digital Acquisition team within the North America Cloud Sales Center. The Digital Acquisition (DA) organization is the engine that converts digital demand into qualified pipeline at scale. We rapidly action high intent inbound interest, build new avenues for prospects to engage with us, and pair that demand with high volume prospecting to acquire new customers and accelerate their growth. In doing so we develop a talent flywheel that scales diverse early career professionals across the AWS Global Sales organization. As a Digital Acquisition leader, you will manage a team of Customer Acquisition Representatives who convert inbound marketing qualified leads and self generated activity into quality top of funnel opportunities. You will own the speed and rigor of our inbound response motion, holding the team to SLA on lead follow up, and you will partner closely with marketing and demand generation to improve lead quality, routing, and the creation of new channels that grow the pool of customers raising their hand to engage AWS. You will exercise ownership in support of strategic efforts to penetrate new markets and verticals, all while educating and building trust with internal stakeholders such as field and inside sellers, marketing partners, and executive leaders to deliver results for the business. As a frontline manager, you will provide in-depth coaching to your team of early career professionals across two levels at once: the repeatable high volume conversion motion that drives our funnel, and the deeper selling craft of qualification, upselling, and carrying a full cycle technical sale. Beyond skills and metrics, you will coach your reps to navigate ambiguous challenges, work effectively within AWS internal structures and cross functional teams, and progress deals when the path forward is not obvious. You will help your reps exceed KPIs, build genuine sales acumen, and progress within the AWS Global Sales organization. Success will be measured by building an operationally excellent team that converts demand quickly and efficiently. You will live in the funnel math, lead to meeting, meeting to opportunity, activity to pipeline, and response time to SLA, relying on data provided by operations teams as well as analysis you generate yourself to dive deep into performance trends and inform decisions. You will not only run the operating model, you will improve it. As a manager, you will be responsible for upholding Amazon's goal of Striving to be Earth's Best Employer through effective hiring, people management, coaching, and culture building. Key job responsibilities Own the inbound demand conversion motion: manage the team to rapidly action marketing qualified leads within SLA, converting high intent inbound interest into scheduled meetings and qualified opportunities for Field Sales progression. Drive digital demand and build new avenues for hand raisers to engage DA reps, partnering with marketing and demand generation on lead quality, routing, campaign experimentation, and new engagement channels. Manage the team in building top of funnel pipeline through effective high volume prospecting alongside inbound conversion, generating qualified opportunities at scale. Oversee all aspects of individual and team-wide coaching to develop early career talent across both the repeatable conversion motion and deeper full cycle selling craft, including qualification, upselling, technical deal progression, and Amazon Leadership Principles based competencies. Provide dedicated coaching to help reps navigate ambiguous challenges, work within AWS internal structures and cross functional teams, and progress deals when the path forward is unclear. Identify internal and external challenges and build scalable mechanisms that improve conversion, response time, and demand generation for your immediate team and your extended stakeholder organization. Be the trusted advisor and voice of Digital Acquisition to regional and segment sales leaders, marketing partners, and cross-functional teams through business reviews and cross-functional roundtables. Manage the team to weekly, biweekly, and quarterly performance KPIs and goals including inbound lead response and follow up, outbound calls and activities, meetings scheduled, and opportunity creation, and continuously improve the reporting cadence and dashboards behind them. Grow technical acumen including GenAI tools and understanding of customer business issues through ongoing professional development and direct customer engagement, and coach your team to position GenAI effectively. Contribute to DA and DG-wide initiatives such as culture building, piloting new tools and channels, and rep and manager development

jobs.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. Experienced in HRIS implementation or migration - Experience building reports from scratch - Proactively identify and resolve data quality issues, maintaining high standards for clean, reliable analytics data - Have run operations across multiple countries and entities, including EOR or contractor populations - Are comfortable anywhere across the employee journey, from hire to exit - Pick up new tools quickly and become the person others ask - Enjoy building elegant solutions to messy operational problems Bonus if you have - Worked in Rippling, or implemented it - People management experience - Built reporting in a BI tool, or worked comfortably in SQL - Been in a company through IPO readiness or SOC 2 and SOX preparation WHAT WE'RE NOT LOOKING FOR Someone who waits for a report request and fills it. jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Join the High Power Engineering team supporting SpaceXAI to design, build, operate, and maintain electrical infrastructure for AI training campuses. As a Power System Engineer on the Transmission & Distribution team, you will work with a small on-site team to scale high-capacity power systems on a schedule set by compute demand. The position is based in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other sites.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own the single model of record for the Memphis campus: load flow, short circuit, coordination, arc flash, motor starting, harmonics, transient stability, and EMT studies for grid-forming inverter interaction with generation.
Create and maintain sitewide power budgets, monitoring, and metering for mission-critical assets to optimize visibility and efficiency.
Perform detailed analysis on electrical power systems: one-lines, three-lines, studies that justify relay settings, and as-built model updates after commissioning.
Feed interconnection studies, relay settings, arc-flash labels, and Battery Storage sizing from the same model. Do not allow shadow models in other pillars.
Develop standardized study cases for hall add, storage dispatch, islanding, and black start.
Ensure compliance with NFPA 70, 70B, 70E, NESC, and IEEE standards, prioritizing safety and engineering excellence.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or another engineering discipline.
3+ years of experience in power systems design, analysis, and studies, with a focus on high-power, high-voltage systems.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Experience with power systems analysis software and tools: ETAP, SKM, EasyPower, PowerWorld, Matlab, PSCAD, PSS/E, ASPEN, Simulink, etc.
Experience performing load flow, short-circuit, arc-flash, coordination, and transient stability studies.
Familiarity with industrial power systems up to 345 kV, including switchgear, transformers, BESS, VFDs, motors, distribution systems, UPS/emergency backups, power generation, relaying, metering, protective devices, and networking.
Professional Engineering license or intention to actively seek a PE license.
Experience with CAD software: Revit, AutoCAD, NX, etc.
Demonstrated initiative, creative problem-solving, and strong analytical/engineering fundamentals.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.
Work extended hours and weekends as needed to support construction, energization, and operations.
Remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.
Lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted.
Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies.
Willing to work on-site in Memphis, TN. This is not a remote or hybrid role.
Travel up to 25% for factory witness testing, vendor and OEM engagement, and supporting other sites.
Valid driver's license.

jobs.description: We are seeking a Research Scientist to join our Data Analytics team. Data Analytics is an exciting and growing function, bringing together existing internal expertise with targeted external hiring. Our mission is to turn proprietary data into industry-leading insights on leadership —both to equip our client-facing teams and to generate high-impact intellectual capital. We are a small, collaborative, and intellectually curious team that works closely with colleagues across Technology, Marketing, and the firm’s client-facing practices. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of advanced statistical research, real-world leadership impact, and client engagement, within a firm with unparalleled access to senior decision-makers globally. This role is designed for someone with a strong interest in statistics, applied research, leadership, and business performance , and—critically—the ability to think rigorously about methodological approach. The Research Scientist is expected to frame researchable questions, develop and test hypotheses, and select and apply appropriate statistical approaches to address complex, business-critical leadership and governance questions. This includes determining how a question should be answered—not only what to analyze—by drawing on approaches such as regression frameworks, quasi-experimental designs, survival or event-history analysis, latent-variable models, or Bayesian methods, depending on the research objective and data structure. In addition to delivering rigorous research, the role requires the ability to translate analytical work into tangible client impact —through advisory support, live client interactions, analytics demonstrations, and proof-of-value work that helps position analytics as a differentiating capability. We explore questions such as: what characteristics make some leaders more successful than others? How do contextual conditions shape leadership risk and performance over time? How do culture, governance, and leadership interact to influence organizational outcomes? In this role, your primary focus will be to: Design and support hypothesis-driven statistical research , including the formulation of testable hypotheses, definition of identification strategies, and critical evaluation of assumptions (e.g., causal vs. non-causal inference). Apply advanced statistical methodologies —including regression and generalized linear models, quasi-experimental methods (e.g., matching, difference-in-differences), survival and time-to-event analysis, latent-variable approaches, and Bayesian frameworks—to guide model selection, validation, robustness testing, and interpretation. Translate analytical findings into clear, executive-ready narratives , producing research memos, client-facing materials, and thought-leadership content that connect methodology and evidence to insight. Partner closely with the Lead Data Scientist to design, execute, validate, and document rigorous quantitative analyses aligned with high research standards. Actively participate in client-facing analytical work , supporting consultants in live engagements where data and insight strengthen leadership advisory. Deliver or co-deliver analytics demonstrations , showing how data and analytical tools can address client needs. Design and support Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Proof-of-Value exercises, tailored to client-specific challenges and strategic questions. Help translate analytical capabilities into compelling value propositions , supporting early-stage client conversations and contributing to the origination of analytics-related opportunities. LOCATION Like the rest of the firm, the Data Analytics team works globally, with professionals located in Amsterdam and in the United States. Our strong preference is for a colleague to join our Amsterdam office. KEY RELATIONSHIPS Reports to: Lead Data Scientist, Data Analytics (Amsterdam) Other key relationships: Head of Data Analytics Data Analytics team members/colleagues Industry/Function Practice Directors Marketing and other internal stakeholders (Operations, Finance, etc.) Data Engineering / Technology partners (as needed for research enablement) Client-facing Consultants and Practice Teams Business development / proposal stakeholders, as relevant to analytics-led opportunities KEY RESPONSABILITIES Research Design and Methodological Rigor Support the design and execution of proprietary research projects on leadership, governance, culture, and performance. Apply appropriate statistical methodologies under guidance (e.g., regression frameworks, causal and quasi-experimental approaches, time-to-event/survival analysis, Bayesian approaches, latent-structure methods). Contribute to the development, documentation, and stress-testing of internal analytical frameworks, metrics, and indices. Conduct diagnostics, robustness checks, and sensitivity analyses to ensure analytical credibility. Insight Generation and Executive Storytelling Translate statistical findings into clear narratives suitable for senior, non-technical audiences. Draft or co-author internal research memos, client-facing exhibits, and thought-leadership content (e.g., articles, briefing notes, presentation storylines). Support the synthesis of results into executive summaries and high-stakes presentation materials. Client-Facing Analytics & Pre-Sales Contribution Support client engagements where analytics enhances leadership dialogue. Deliver or contribute to analytics demonstrations, showcasing capabilities and insights. Design and support Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Proof-of-Value exercises addressing client-specific challenges. Partner with consultants to tailor analytical outputs to client contexts and decision needs. Contribute to the development of repeatable analytics offerings and scalable solutions. Support revenue generation efforts, helping position analytics in opportunity development while not owning commercial targets directly. Data Usage (Non‑Engineering Focus) Work with curated datasets extracted from the firm’s cloud-based data platforms and research repositories. Identify data limitations, assumptions, and risks relevant to statistical analysis; escalate quality issues where needed. Collaborate with data quality and engineering colleagues while not owning platform development, pipelines, or production systems. Analytical Tooling and Libraries Conduct analysis primarily in Python/SPSS, within a research‑oriented statistical environment that supports exploratory, inferential, and hypothesis‑driven work. Apply tooling appropriate for data manipulation, econometric and regression‑based modeling, quasi‑experimental analysis, survival and event‑history modeling, distributional and diagnostic analysis, and selected unsupervised or latent‑structure methods. Produce clear exploratory and presentation‑ready visualizations to support interpretation and executive‑level storytelling. Emphasize reproducible, well‑documented workflows, aligned with academic and high‑end applied research standards. IDEAL EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Quantitative Social Science , or a related field; an advanced degree ( Master’s or PhD ) is strongly preferred. Approximately 2–5 years of experience in an applied research setting (consulting, academia, think tank, policy institute). Demonstrated ability to apply statistical reasoning to complex, imperfect real-world data. Proven writing ability , including research papers, policy reports, analytical publications, or client-facing research. Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders and translating analysis into actionable insight is a strong plus. TECHNICAL SKILLS Statistical Analysis Strong foundation in parametric and non‑parametric statistical inference and modeling, including regression and generalized linear models, quasi‑experimental approaches for causal reasoning (e.g., propensity score methods, difference‑in‑differences), survival and time‑to‑event analysis, and familiarity with hierarchical or Bayesian thinking where appropriate. Exposure to unsupervised or latent‑structure techniques (e.g., clustering, factor models, PCA) to identify underlying patterns or archetypes in leadership data. Programming and Reproducible Research Proficiency in Python for analysis, reproducible workflows, and data visualization. Comfort working with structured datasets derived from SQL-based environments (SQL proficiency is helpful but not mandatory). Communication of Results Ability to present results clearly through concise exhibits, tables, and narrative summaries. Familiarity with visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) is a plus but not required. CRITICAL CAPABILITIES: Strong statistical and methodological expertise Exceptional ability to communicate complex insights clearly to non-technical audiences Client-facing confidence, including presenting analytical work in live settings Commercial awareness, with the ability to link analytics to client value and opportunity creation Strong consultative mindset bridging research and application High intellectual rigor and attention to detail Self-motivated, collaborative, and able to operate in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description: Team Name: Hearthstone Job Title: Game Director - Hearthstone | Irvine, CA Requisition ID: R027738 Job Description: Pull up a chair and join us by the hearth! Blizzard is looking for a Game Director to join the Hearthstone leadership team. Hearthstone continues to reach millions of players worldwide and has delivered as one of Blizzard’s flagship live-service titles for 12 years running. In this role, you will be joining a veteran leadership team that is united by a passion for card games and player-first development. As Blizzard invests in the next decade and beyond for Hearthstone, we are adding a Game Director to help shape what Hearthstone becomes for millions of players around the world. This role is an opportunity to steward one of gaming’s most beloved strategy franchises while helping define its future across competitive play, social experiences, live operations, and new ways for players to engage with Hearthstone. This added leadership role will own the game’s near-term creative, gameplay, and live-service direction, while partnering closely with Hearthstone’s senior game director and the rest of Hearthstone’s senior leadership on the long-term strategy for Hearthstone’s future. The role spans Hearthstone’s constructed card game formats, Battlegrounds, and live operations initiatives, helping shape both the immediate player experience and the ongoing evolution of Hearthstone. You will help set the creative and strategic direction for a game that has delighted players for over a decade, ensuring it continues to surprise, entertain, and evolve for many years to come. We are looking for a strategic, player-focused design leader who brings deep live-service leadership experience, strong genre-relevant judgment, and the ability to align teams around a compelling vision. As Game Director, you will help translate player needs, business opportunities, and creative ambition into durable priorities and clear direction. The ideal candidate thrives in collaborative environments, develops creative talent, communicates effectively with senior stakeholders, and holds a high bar for quality while championing the player at every step. This role offers a flexible hybrid work week, with a mix of remote and on-site days. While hybrid is the standard arrangement, you're also welcome to work on site full-time if you prefer. Champion quality in the delivery of fun and engaging card sets, providing actionable feedback and roadblock removal necessary for the design team to deliver on quality targets and business objectives. Proven ability to lead, grow, and inspire design teams, championing design craft while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Deep understanding of “games as service” and the live-service loop, especially through the lens of free-to-play games. Exceptional ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups, including executive leadership, product, publishing, marketing, user research, and analytics teams. Strong project management skills and ability to maintain a strategic vision. SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
We are hiring Medium Voltage Electricians to join SpaceXAI’s internal construction team supporting the rapid build-out of our data centers. This is a traveling role — you will mobilize with project teams to active construction sites, install and commission medium-voltage systems at 12.47 kV, 13.8 kV, and 34.5 kV, and move with the work as new facilities come online.
You will install e-house medium-voltage switchgear (MVSG), generator step-up transformers (GSUs), 15 kV and 35 kV cable, and duct bank; support hipot/VLF testing; and work adjacent to live campus buses. This is a construction and commissioning role: build new medium-voltage infrastructure from drawings and turn it over. It is not a facilities-maintenance or operating-plant role.
This is an hourly position with overtime. Expect 80% or more travel on a rotation, with per diem.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Travel with internal construction and electrical teams to project sites to install, terminate, and test medium-voltage systems, including e-house medium-voltage switchgear (MVSG), generator step-up transformers (GSUs), 15 kV and 35 kV cable, duct bank, and associated control wiring.
Pull, rack, land, and terminate 15 kV and 35 kV cable using manufacturer-approved stress cones and terminations.
Install medium-voltage duct bank, manholes, and raceway for 12.47 kV, 13.8 kV, and 34.5 kV circuits.
Support hipot/VLF and insulation-resistance testing of new medium-voltage cable and gear: prepare, isolate, ground, and stand the work with commissioning.
Work adjacent to live campus medium-voltage buses under switching orders, clearances, and LOTO.
Read and interpret medium-voltage one-lines, physical drawings, cable schedules, and termination drawings; produce as-builts and test records.
Ensure compliance with NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA 1910.269, and SpaceXAI safety and quality standards, including switching, clearance, LOTO, and arc-flash protocols.
Collaborate with contractors, engineers, and operations teams to deliver projects on time with zero incidents.
Participate in constructability reviews and provide field feedback to improve designs.
Mobilize quickly between project locations as construction phases and priorities shift.
